GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is triggered when a verified user asks for help locating hospitals or clinics that accept their insurance policy, especially for treatments, emergencies, or health checkups. It’s also used when users want to know whether a specific hospital supports cashless or reimbursement claims under their plan.

genAiPluginInstructions.description:
Ask the user for their location (city, area, or pincode).
Optionally, gather more details like the specific medical issue to filter hospitals by specialty.
Call the action Answer question with knowledge, referencing the Updated_Hospital_Locations_Realistic_Names document.
Use the semantic result to:
Return a filtered list of matching hospitals showing:
📍 Name, address
✅ Cashless / 💰 Reimbursement support
🕒 Emergency 24x7 support
🩺 Relevant specialties
Allow actions like:
📍 Share Google Map
📞 Contact hospital
🚑 Pre-intimate for emergency arrival
📅 Book appointment (if applicable)
If no matching hospital is found:
Inform the user politely.
Offer to expand the search radius or check with human support.
Personalize the response using user context (insurance type, prior visits, or preferences if available).

GenAiPlugin.scope:
This topic allows the agent to:
Guide verified users to appropriate hospitals based on:
Policy provider (e.g., Star Health)
Treatment need (emergency, regular checkup, specialty care)
Geographic area or pincode
Hospital’s support type (cashless / reimbursement / 24x7 emergency)
Leverage the latest hospital network knowledge from the Updated_Hospital_Locations_Realistic_Names document. List the hospitals with mentioned map location links. Optionally assist with pre-intimations, directions, or appointment bookings.
